name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Hold-padding input buffer for Geometry Dash with F6 in-level stage cycling (2/2 -> 4/4 -> 8/8 -> 16/8 -> OFF).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, every input is passed through untouched.

only-when-airborne.name: Predictive: only pad early clicks
only-when-airborne.description: For cube, ball, robot and spider, only pad clicks that started while airborne (the ones that can be lost). Clicks made on the ground stay 100% raw.

buffer-wave.name: Buffer the wave
buffer-wave.description: Apply the (shorter) Wave window while you are a wave. Turn off to keep the wave 100% raw.

buffer-flight-modes.name: Buffer ship, UFO and swing
buffer-flight-modes.description: Also pad clicks in ship, UFO and swing. Off by default because it adds extra thrust to short taps.

show-toast.name: Show stage toast
show-toast.description: Show an in-game notification when you press F6.

debug-log.name: Log every padded click
debug-log.description: Print each padded release to the Geode console, with its length in ticks. Use this to verify timing.
